fusions.name: Snagging Quill
fusions.desc: Lashes out a strand that deals 4 damage, up to 1.3 times that at its full 4 tiles, and slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristling Ruff
fusions.desc: You puff out every strand at once, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles, each with a 40% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Plumage Screen
fusions.desc: Spreads a screen of braided plumage 6 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fluffed Up
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 7 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
